metadata.title: The Adivasi Question | बोधघाट परियोजना - नफ़ा और नुकसान | Main Bhi Bharat Explainer
metadata.description:
The proposed Bodhghat project in Chhattisgarh's Bastar district is facing stiff opposition from the region's tribal population. The dam that is to be built on the Indravati river was first proposed as a hydropower project, but is now being touted as an irrigation project that will serve the adivasi population in and around Bastar. But the big question revolves round the rehabilitation plan for the affected tribals. The Chhattisgarh government says it will first rehabilitate the adivasis, and only then begin work on the project. In this episode of The Adivasi Question, we explore both sides of the argument.
